changelog: Channels in the rail can now be reordered by dragging - the server has always stored a position for each one, but nothing let you change it. Also adds a "make all equal" button next to a channel's sources: distinct from the existing "distribute to 100%", which only rescales whatever ratio is already there, this gives every source the same share outright - for a weighted-random channel whose sources plainly were not equally likely.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
